name: Alpha Zoo
short_description: A gentle alphabet zoo: wander and meet an animal for every letter.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: A gentle alphabet zoo: wander and meet an animal for every letter.

identity.core_loop: Walk, find a letter, meet its animal, hear its name.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Soft, slow, no fail state; made for small children.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Animals and letters are in the world itself; almost no interface.

identity.art_direction: Bright simple low-poly with friendly shapes.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Kids learn best when the world itself is the lesson; no menus between the child and the animal.
